name: Retro Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Retro Mahjong is an elegant Mahjong style game in a classic 8-bit animation style. Nostalgia is back and it just might be the wave of the future. Whether you like things from the 70's, 80's or thousands of years ago, we're pretty certain that this version of Mahjong is perfect for particular tastes. It is nothing short of revolutionary to take a game that is hundreds of years old, and thought of as a classic -like Mahjong- and then combine it with a vintage aesthetic like the green-hued pixel bit animation of the late 1980s. The combination is magical. Now you can match pixelated lightning bolts, 8-bit bombs, and a variety of 80's gaming tropes as you play through classic game mechanics which have been tested and approved for hundreds of years by dozens of generations. Mahjong is truly a timeless game and by adding its mechanics to a beloved retro art theme, we hope to deliver it countless new generations. So, sit down and prepare to enjoy a game that your ancient ancestors played in an art style that your parents loved!
